questions.prompt: Explain how the Atlas Global Workforce codebase is layered, and why persistence is kept in memory behind repositories.

keyPoints.text: The backend is Express-style TypeScript split into controllers, services, repositories, middleware, config and observability.
keyPoints.quote: Express-style TypeScript with controllers, services, repositories, middleware, config, and observability modules.

keyPoints.text: The frontend is organized by feature folders with typed API clients, auth context and query hooks.
keyPoints.quote: React feature folders with typed API clients, auth context, query hooks, reusable UI states

keyPoints.text: DTOs shared by API and frontend live in one package.
keyPoints.quote: packages/shared contains DTOs used by both API and frontend.

keyPoints.text: Storage is deliberately in-memory, hidden behind repositories.
keyPoints.quote: intentionally in-memory, hidden behind repositories so persistence concerns remain teachable without infrastructure.

keyPoints.text: The artifact is a teaching tool, not a runnable product.
keyPoints.quote: it is to show how a realistic TypeScript/Node plus React codebase gains shape over time

questions.prompt: Walk through how the snapshot sequence grows the system, naming where the domain, relationships, refactoring and data maturity arrive.

keyPoints.text: It starts by proving front and back end can talk before any business logic.
keyPoints.quote: Prove the frontend and backend can talk before any business complexity exists.

keyPoints.text: Snapshot 01 gives client companies a domain shape behind a repository.
keyPoints.quote: Give client companies a real domain shape and hide storage behind a repository boundary.

keyPoints.text: Work agreements arrive as child records of client companies.
keyPoints.quote: Model work agreements as child records attached to client companies.

keyPoints.text: Refactoring happens only after duplication has become painful.
keyPoints.quote: Revisit earlier shortcuts once duplicated controller and fetch logic become painful.

keyPoints.text: The frontend then moves from manual fetch state to cache-aware data flows.
keyPoints.quote: Move from manual fetch state to cache-aware frontend data flows.

keyPoints.text: A relationship lookup is shown becoming slow and fixed with batching.
keyPoints.quote: Show how a harmless-looking relationship lookup becomes slow, then fix it with batching.

questions.prompt: Describe the study loop the journal prescribes for each snapshot and why the backend and frontend paths revisit earlier snapshots.

keyPoints.text: Start from the Goal in the snapshot's NOTES.md.
keyPoints.quote: Read the Goal in the snapshot NOTES.md.

keyPoints.text: Make a prediction before opening the code.
keyPoints.quote: Answer "Predict before you read" before opening code/.

keyPoints.text: Compare with the previous snapshot to see the actual change.
Check the key decisions against your prediction and weigh the tradeoff.
keyPoints.quote: Check the Key decisions against your prediction and ask what tradeoff you would have made.

keyPoints.text: A backend engineer's path runs through validation, auth, observability and the N+1 fix.
Fullstack engineers revisit 07 and 11 because revisiting earlier decisions is normal work.
keyPoints.quote: revisit 07 and 11 to see why revisiting earlier decisions is normal engineering work.
